name: 0046 block 3 - VFD live, sinus OFF, 10 min
description: BLOCK 3. VFD energized and motor turning slowly under MANUAL/LOCAL drive control (operator sets the speed), sinus output filter OFF. Delta against block 2B = drive EMI at the sensor channels with no output filtering. THIS PROFILE DOES NOT TOUCH THE DRIVE. The rpm schedule is deliberately empty and vfd_stop_on_end is false, so the runner never sends a frequency, never starts and never stops the motor -- the operator is in control of the drive by hand. It only acquires, for the stated duration, and logs telemetry. Ticket 0046 electrical-noise characterization. Same acquisition and scope_channels as a normal run, so blocks compare without rescaling. Heater relay must be OFF for every electrical block (it is its own EMI source, ticket 0035) -- it only comes back as its own factor in block 6. BASELINE IS BLOCK 2B (20260930_112905), NOT 2A. Kim split block 2 into 2A (the 24 V switch-mode -> linear PSU swap) and 2B (heater/temp control box off), and 2B left THE BOX SWITCHED OFF. The ladder's whole point is one variable at a time, so leave the box off for this block: then the only change from the preceding configuration is the drive, and the delta means the drive. Switching the box back on at the same time as energizing the drive would change two things at once and neither could be attributed. We already know what the box does (it halves AE's 129.5/131.5 kHz pair, 2B), so nothing is lost by leaving it off. ALSO NOTE: max_consecutive_modbus_errors is deliberately left at its normal default here, unlike blocks 0/2/6. The VFD is energized in this block, so vfd.get_status() answers and the runner's safety stop is doing its proper job again — do not raise it.
